Override.AttributionNote: 聚雲吹萬真禪師語錄, abbot's-quarters statement. Chuiwan Guangzhen is the exact speaker: he says the ancients called it the abbot's ground, while this old monk calls it the abbot's room, where buddhas and patriarchs will be smelted.
